faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Nicobar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DCPU Nicobar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DCPU Nicobar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 12 vacancies are available for various posts in the District Child Protection Unit Nicobar (DCPU Nicobar) recruitment drive for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DCPU Nicobar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised under DCPU Nicobar Recruitment 2026 is 50 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for specific categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary for each post, ranging from 10th pass to MBBS and Graduation in specific fields like Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Commerce, and Mathematics. Specific diplomas are also required for some positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the recruited candidates ranges from Rs. 7944 to Rs. 18536 per month, depending on the specific post they are appointed to. The detailed salary for each post is provided in the article.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DCPU Nicobar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DCPU Nicobar Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DCPU Nicobar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the District Child Protection Unit Nicobar, located in Car Nicobar, Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Therefore, selected candidates will likely be posted in this region.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational/experience certificates, along with the duly filled application form.
